Overview

Dover is a city in DE with a population of 38,000. Delaware’s capital with Dover Air Force Base, NASCAR racing, and historic downtown. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
